name: gg-individual-income-tax
description: Prepare ordinary calendar-year 2026 individual tax working papers for the Guernsey income-tax jurisdiction. Cap screening and conditional full-year cap comparisons are included; full statutory cap eligibility, resident-only elections, trusts, pension encashments and foreign-tax relief remain outside these calculations. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
